messages:
alyssa: Nightly seqpath prober finished on AVX2 pool. Noticed kernel-pick shift around seqlen ~2k — p99 up ~18% on KV-cache sensitive traces. Uploading trimmed logs.

runtime-ci-bot: prober-run | id=ci-prober-20260317-34 | pool=avx2-x8 | candidates=472 | status=completed :white_check_mark:

marc: which workload/trace shows the regression? can you paste the pick diff or a short snippet? :eyes:

alyssa: here's one example from trace "wiki-long-seq-2k":
```
seqlen=2048
old_pick: matmul-avx2-sliced@v7 (latency p99=42.3ms)
new_pick: matmul-generic@v3 (latency p99=50.0ms)
reason: autotune-score drop -0.18
kvcache_sensitive=true
```

devin: hmm, autotune-score drop suggests scoring function penalized the avx2 path (maybe due to throughput vs memory pressure). Did the microprobe measure perf counters for that candidate?

alyssa: microprobe logs (trimmed):
```
# perf stat -e cycles,cache-misses,L1-dcache-loads ./microprobe --candidate matmul-avx2-sliced --seq 2048
cycles: 1.20e9
L3-misses: 124k
branch-misses: 1.2k
# throughput: 18.3k tokens/s
```

marc: L3 miss delta could explain latency. Was batch-auto enabled for this night? PR#4123 changed batch selection heuristics recently.

alyssa: yes, run used autopick=v3 + batch-auto=on. config excerpt we used: 
```
autopick: v3
batch_auto_thresholds: [8, 32, 128, 512]
kvcache_mode: enabled
seqlen_buckets: [128, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]
```

devin: OK. I'll queue an isolated microbench with perf + kvcache-sim and batch_auto=off to see if pick flips back to avx2-sliced. tagging @marc

marc: queued isolate job id=ci-micro-1769996679 (microbench + perf + kv-sim) — will post artifacts when done. Also adding a targeted canary to the nightly smoke suite so we catch this earlier.

alyssa: thanks. marking this P0 for candidate-picks. I added repro steps and the short trace to the ticket. If isolate reproduces, we should consider adjusting the autotune scoring weights (favoring L3-friendly kernels for kvcache=true) or tweak the batch thresholds. :bug:

runtime-ci-bot: job queued | id=ci-micro-1769996679 | status=queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:
